qa: You may look at all the cards in your security stack without revealing them to your opponent. Then, choose 1 card to add to your hand, reveal only that card to your opponent and add it to your hand.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] You may search your security stack for 1 card with [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] in its traits, reveal it, and add it to your hand. If you added a card, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. Then, shuffle your security stack. [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When you play [LadyDevimon] or [Mirei Mikagura], gain 1 memory.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Opponent's Turn] While you have a purple Digimon in play, all of your Digimon with [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] in their traits gain ＜Blocker＞.
